question: Where is the fair of Pir Budhan held every year in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Madhya Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **Muslim saint Pir Budhan's shrine **hosts the Pir Budhan festival throughout the months of **August and September.**
 
• Since roughly** 250 years ago**, this fair has been held in the **Samvara area of the Shivpuri district, Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• **Baba Budhan Ali Shah** is another name for **Pir Budhan Shah**.
 
• He was a revered** Sufi pir** who discussed **religion with Guru Nanak **in Rawalpindi and eventually embraced **Gurmat philosophy **during the reign of **Guru Har Gobind.**
 
• **Khajuraho Dance Festival, Ujjain Kumbh Mela, Lokrang Festival Nagaji Fair etc. **are some of the fairs of MP.
